name: nvoos-gateway
description: Connects Claude Code to the NV oOS MCP Gateway — the public, fleet-scoped endpoint for NV oOS WordPress sites. Namespaced <site-slug>_<tool> tools (demo_* on the public demo site): environment status, deep research with citations, content workflows, and store tools over streamable HTTP, authenticated with a site-scoped gateway key or OAuth.

api_key.title: Gateway API key
api_key.description: Public API key issued by the NV oOS gateway operator (keys are site-scoped with server-side tool allowlists).
